# Fusco Orsini & Associates

> > Independent insurance agency serving San Diego and California with specialized business insurance, contractor coverage, and personal insurance solutions.

Fusco Orsini & Associates (FOA) is led by principals Michael Fusco and Valeri Orsini, providing comprehensive commercial insurance programs for contractors, MSPs, automotive services, entertainment businesses, and industrial operations. The agency offers workers' compensation, general liability, commercial umbrella, and specialized coverage across California.

## Key Topics

- California business insurance
- Contractor insurance and construction coverage
- Workers' compensation
- General liability and commercial umbrella
- San Diego insurance services
- Specialized industry insurance (MSP, automotive, entertainment)
- Garage liability insurance
- Equipment and floater policies
- Michael Fusco and Valeri Orsini leadership
- Commercial insurance programs
- Liability coverage solutions
- Property & casualty insurance
- Audit support services

## Specialized Business Insurance

- [California MSP Insurance (Request a Quote Online)](https://www.foagency.com/business-insurance/specialized-business-insurance/california-msp-insurance): Managed service provider insurance: E&O, cyber liability, workers' comp
- [California Glass & Window Installer Insurance](https://www.foagency.com/business-insurance/specialized-business-insurance/california-glass-and-window-installer-insurance): Specialized insurance for CA glass & window installation contractors
- [California Insulation Installer Insurance](https://www.foagency.com/business-insurance/specialized-business-insurance/california-insulation-installer-insurance): Contractor insurance for CA insulation installers: liability & workers' comp
- [California Garage Liability Insurance](https://www.foagency.com/business-insurance/california-garage-liability-insurance): Garage liability coverage for CA auto repair shops and dealerships
- [California Brake & Alignment Service Insurance](https://www.foagency.com/business-insurance/specialized-business-insurance/california-brake-and-alignment-service-insurance): Specialized coverage for CA brake and alignment automotive shops
- [California Touring & Concert Promoter Insurance](https://www.foagency.com/business-insurance/specialized-business-insurance/california-touring-and-concert-promoter-insurance): Entertainment insurance for CA concert promoters and touring events
- [California Industrial Waste Reclaimers Insurance](https://www.foagency.com/business-insurance/specialized-business-insurance/industrial-waste-reclaimers-insurance): Specialized coverage for CA industrial waste reclaimers and recyclers
- [California Paper & Cardboard Processing Plant Insurance](https://www.foagency.com/business-insurance/specialized-business-insurance/california-paper-and-cardboard-processing-plant-insurance): Insurance for CA paper & cardboard processing plants and recycling facilities

## Contractor & Equipment Insurance

- [California Contractor Equipment Insurance](https://www.foagency.com/business-insurance/california-contractor-equipment-insurance): Equipment coverage for CA contractors: theft, damage, transit protection
